subject.title: feat(control-ui): agent identity editor, Settings-homed Agents page, scalable chip switcher

question: Should the footer agent chip permanently control a shared default scope across Usage, Automations, Tasks, Workboard, and Sessions, and may moving Agents into Settings remove existing customizable sidebar pins?
rationale: This changes established navigation, persisted browser preferences, and the default visibility of several pages; tests can verify mechanics but cannot decide the intended product and upgrade contract.

options.title: Preserve navigation compatibility
options.body: Keep Settings → Agents as the canonical location while retaining existing Agents sidebar pins and approve shared page scope only with an explicit All agents escape and upgrade proof.

options.title: Adopt the new contract
options.body: Intentionally remove Agents pins and make the chip the global scope controller, with an explicit preference migration, release-facing explanation, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Split the feature
options.body: Land the identity editor and scalable switcher separately while deferring cross-page scope and navigation relocation to a narrower product-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Preserve navigation compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep Settings → Agents as the canonical location while retaining existing Agents sidebar pins and approve shared page scope only with an explicit All agents escape and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Control UI feature history and self-assigned product-scale branch make steipete the best available owner for the navigation and shared-scope decision.
